lead.head_en: Forest produce centres in the Rampachodavaram and Chinturu agency areas
lead.head_te: రంపచోడవరం, చింతూరు ఏజెన్సీల్లో అటవీ ఉత్పత్తుల కేంద్రాలు
lead.en: Under the Centre's tribal livelihood scheme, the Rampachodavaram tribal development agency area has 110 forest produce centres sanctioned and 100 working. The Chinturu area has 56 sanctioned and 52 working. Each area also has 4 centres under a second scheme for the most vulnerable tribes, all 4 working. At these centres tribal groups process and pack forest produce to sell.
lead.te: కేంద్ర గిరిజన జీవనోపాధి పథకం కింద రంపచోడవరం ఐటీడీఏ ప్రాంతానికి 110 అటవీ ఉత్పత్తుల కేంద్రాలు మంజూరయ్యాయి; 100 పనిచేస్తున్నాయి. చింతూరు ప్రాంతానికి 56 మంజూరయ్యాయి; 52 పనిచేస్తున్నాయి. అత్యంత వెనుకబడిన గిరిజన తెగల కోసం ఉన్న మరో పథకం కింద రెండు ప్రాంతాల్లోనూ 4 చొప్పున కేంద్రాలు ఉన్నాయి; అన్నీ పనిచేస్తున్నాయి. ఈ కేంద్రాల్లో గిరిజన సంఘాలు అటవీ ఉత్పత్తులను శుద్ధి చేసి, ప్యాక్ చేసి అమ్ముతాయి.
lead.quote: ITDA-wise details of VDVKs in the State of Andhra Pradesh is given at Annexure-II. (b): These Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs) have undertaken processing and value addition activities based on the availability of Minor Forest Produce (MFP) and local demands. The products processed, inter alia, include.  Nannari Sharbat: 10,000 litres (multiple VDVKs)  Amla pulp: 300 kg; Amla candy  Millets: Sama Rice (50–850 kg), Samalu (300–550 kg), Korra (450 kg), Ragi Flour/Powder (50–1,471 kg), Millet Powder (190–800 kg)  Coffee Powder: 1,800 kg  Broomsticks/Hill Brooms: 115 to 150,000 bundles/pieces  Cashew Nuts: 120 kg to 2.5 tonnes (including direct sales of 1 MT)  Tamarind/Tamarind Cakes: 60 kg to 4 tonnes  Turmeric Powder: 105.2 kg to 16 tonnes  Chilli Powder: up to 1.6 tonnes  Bamboo Furniture/Products: up to 40 tonnes  Honey: up to 190 kg  Mahua Oil: up to 500 kg  Adda Leaf Plates/Bowls: up to 15,000 plates and 5,000 bowls  Annatto Seeds: up to 2 tonnes  Black Gram/Pulses/Maize: processed in varying quantities. (c): A total of 1,29,420 tribal beneficiaries, including Scheduled Tribe women, are actively participating in VDVKs established under PMJVM and PM-JANMAN in the state of Andhra Pradesh. The schemes have facilitated value addition and marketing of Minor Forest Produce (MFP) and other tribal products and these VDVKs have generated income of ₹508.80 lakh through sales for their tribal members. (d): Year-wise details of funds is given at Annexure-III. (e): Under VDVK Programme, Entrepreneurship Awareness Programmes (EAPs), Entrepreneurship Development Programmes (EDPs) and training programmes on sustainable collection, primary processing, value addition, grading, packaging, quality control, branding, entrepreneurship development and marketing of MFP have been conducted. A total of 1,20,237 tribal beneficiaries have been trained under the programme as on 30.06.2026. Marketing linkages have been established through TRIFED, State Implementing Agencies, Van Dhan outlets, exhibitions, fairs, buyer-seller meets, e-commerce platforms and other institutional marketing channels to facilitate the sale of value-added MFP products produced by VDVKs. (f) A multi-tier monitoring and accountability mechanism has been put in place for effective implementation of the Van Dhan Vikas Kendras (VDVKs), which includes geo- tagging, regular monitoring through review meetings, field visits and progress reports by the State Implementing Agency (GCC Ltd.), ITDAs, District-level officials and TRIFED, periodic inspections, financial monitoring through scrutiny of expenditure statements and Utilisation Certificates (UCs), and statutory/internal audits. Wherever delays or deficiencies are noticed, the concerned Implementing Agencies/ITDAs are instructed to expedite operationalisation, improve fund utilisation, submit pending Utilisation Certificates, strengthen value-addition activities, enhance marketing efforts, and ensure timely reporting and compliance. lead.head_en: ₹12.60 crore to make Rampachodavaram a 100-bed hospital
lead.en: Upgrading the community health centre at Rampachodavaram from 50 to 100 beds, with NABARD funds, has an administrative sanction of ₹12.60 crore. The table prints it under Alluri Sitharama Raju district, which Rampachodavaram was part of before the 2026 change.
lead.te: నాబార్డ్ నిధులతో రంపచోడవరం సామాజిక ఆరోగ్య కేంద్రాన్ని 50 నుంచి 100 పడకలకు పెంచే పనికి ₹12.60 కోట్ల పరిపాలనా అనుమతి ఉంది. పట్టికలో దీన్ని అల్లూరి సీతారామరాజు జిల్లా కింద చూపారు; 2026 మార్పుకు ముందు రంపచోడవరం ఆ జిల్లాలోనే ఉండేది.

lead.head_en: 147 farmers got help to buy farm machines in 2025-26
lead.en: Under the Centre's scheme that helps farmers buy farm machines for their own use, our district had 147 beneficiaries in 2025-26. The table shows 0 for 2024-25.
